description: This file defines data structures and methods related to DFA states used in the ANTLR parser generator, including DFAState and PredPrediction classes, with associated methods for managing DFA states and configurations.

classes.name: PredPrediction
classes.description: Represents a predicate and its associated predicted alternative.

classes.name: DFAState
classes.description: Represents a state in the DFA with configurations, edges, and prediction info.

methods.name: NewPredPrediction
methods.description: Constructor for PredPrediction, initializes with a SemanticContext predicate and an alternative number.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of PredPrediction.

methods.name: NewDFAState
methods.description: Constructor for DFAState, initializes with a state number and configuration set.

methods.name: GetAltSet
methods.description: Returns all alternative numbers from the DFAState's configurations.

methods.name: getEdges
methods.description: Returns the edges (transitions) from this DFAState.

methods.name: numEdges
methods.description: Returns the number of edges from this DFAState.

methods.name: getIthEdge
methods.description: Returns the ith edge (transition) from this DFAState.

methods.name: setEdges
methods.description: Sets the edges (transitions) for this DFAState.

methods.name: setIthEdge
methods.description: Sets the ith edge (transition) for this DFAState.

methods.name: setPrediction
methods.description: Sets the predicted alternative for this DFAState.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of DFAState, including its prediction and configurations.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the DFAState based on its configurations.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this DFAState and another based on configuration sets.
